Hi all - two questions

1. My husband registered our marriage with MH last week, but it is still requiring he fill out the form MR/6 to change his martial status when we go to apply for the spouse visa online. Should he fill this out again?
2. Presumably my current visa (student) will expire before we have our first appointment scheduled. Should I go to MH during walk-in hours to request that they move me to a B2 while I wait? What documents should I bring for this?

Thank you!
